title: Oxygen Reference
description: The reference rule shared by every schema field that names another asset or file (Oxygen/Content/Docs/virtual_paths.md, References). A reference is a virtual path in another mount, or text relative to the folder that holds the referring file. This definition refuses what a pattern can express; the cooker resolves the reference and reports the rule's vpath.* code for the rest: the segment rules a pattern cannot state (NFC, unassigned code points, U+0080-U+009F controls, the 255-byte bound), a climb above the mount, absolute text in the file's own mount, and derived content in an asset reference.

reference.description: Absolute ('/Engine/Materials/Default.omat': a mount name, then a path in it) or relative ('Brick.otex', './Brick.otex', '../Textures/Brick.otex'). Relative text starts with one './' or any number of '../', then one or more segments; no '.' or '..' after that, no empty segment and no trailing '/'. No segment starts with a space, ends with a space or a dot, or is a Windows device name; the leaf has an extension. No C0 control characters, DEL or any of \ : * ? " < > |. Segments are plain text: no percent-encoding, and no asset:/// URIs.
